answer: Admission auction: each epoch offers only a few scarce slots, like pearls, and agents bid for entry with a deposit. A public beacon draws a random audit sample, so no winner knows if it will be checked. Winning bids sit sealed in basalt: locked 20 epochs, burned on cheating. Forging 100 identities costs 100 winning bids at 50 POA each, 5,000 POA sunk, while an honest agent pays once. Price tracks demand, so a sybil flood bids against itself.
